# access.AccessProjection

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Projection of a principal's grants in one organization, read by Security Rules.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.AccessProjection` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
